newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sime in S$93.9 mln Singapore property buy.
newsitem.headline: Sime in S$93.9 mln Singapore property buy.

text.p: Sime Singapore Ltd (SSL), a unit of Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby Bhd, said on Friday its tender of Singapore $93.9 million for a property in the heart of Singapore's financial district had been successful.
The deal, due to be completed in three months, gives the company a 999-year lease on the Carlton Building on Cecil Street, SSL said in a statement.
The building would be used to house some Sime Darby group businesses, including Sime Bank.
Finance for the purchase of the site from Carlton Investment (Singapore) Pte Ltd would be through a combination of internal funds and bank borrowings.
